description: Exact-only deduplication policy for processed corpus v0.1. No fuzzy, MinHash, or embedding similarity.

within_source_exact.description: Drop exact duplicate lines within a single source, keeping the first occurrence in file order.

cross_source_exact.description: Optional: when true, drop exact duplicate lines across sources according to source_priority, while recording all source attributions in metadata.

notes: Preserve source boundaries in corpus/ (do not merge into one anonymous file).
If cross-source exact dedup retains only one text instance, still record all source IDs that contained the line.
Do not run processed-level deduplication against real outputs unless eligibility gates pass.
